component.description: The component this object classifies. Exactly this value.

value.description: The industry_vertical value: one of ["FinTech","HealthTech / MedTech","SportsTech","Analytics / ML","Data Platform SaaS","SaaS — Other","Manufacturing tech / Industrial IoT","Enterprise Tech / Hyperscalers","Pharma / Life Sciences","EdTech","LegalTech","ClimaTech","Government / Public Sector","Pure Hardware / Consumer Electronics","Telecom / 5G Infrastructure","E-commerce / Retail Tech","Pre-product Startups"], or null when the facts do not support a defensible answer.

evidence.description: At most 6 items, each "<fact_key>: <value>" and under 200 characters. The limits are not expressible in strict mode; they are still the contract.

confidence.description: high when a fact states it or two agree; medium when inferred; low when extrapolating.

missing_inputs.description: Fact keys you needed and did not get. Empty array when none.
